decision.justification: Selected 'weighted weighted by w8' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9454. Series context: trend strength 0.9575 and seasonal strength 0.1527; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.08); 2 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.221.
